title: SWS: Fewer Filipinos follow Duterte trial than past impeachments

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Fewer Filipinos closely followed the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte compared with past impeachment proceedings, the Social Weather Stations (SWS) reported. According to its survey conducted from Sept. 21 to 27, only 42 percent of adult Filipinos followed Duterte’s impeachment trial “very or somewhat” closely. The SWS said this was lower than the 47 percent recorded in January 2001, during the impeachment trial of then-President Joseph Estrada. Meanwhile, 52 percent and 54 percent of Filipinos followed the impeachment trial of then-Chief Justice Renato Corona, according to the SWS surveys conducted in March and May 2012, respectively.
